sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: Italian brand Lapalma has collaborated with architect and designer Raffaella Mangiarotti on a new kaleidoscopic palette of colourways for its catalogue. Lapalma describes its new colour palette, which debuted at Salone del Mobile, as a "chromatic alphabet" of 16 distinct shades that can be applied to a spectrum of its products.
